_comment: Multi-UAV PPO trained on the ns-3-calibrated reward (reward_mode 'calibrated', ml/calibrated_model.py: per-user PDR including hidden-node collisions and contention, fitted to ns-3 runs on training scenarios only). Same training scenarios, start randomisation and step budget as configs/training_network.json, so the two policies differ only in the reward. Held-out evaluation scenarios (incl. flood_shelters from configs/eval_network.json) are never used here.

sparse_clusters.name: Sparse Survivor Clusters (training only)
sparse_clusters.purpose: Training-only: separated survivor clusters over a mid-size area.

wide_edge.name: Wide Area, Edge-Heavy (training only)
wide_edge.purpose: Training-only: users concentrated near the edges of a large area.
